name: Lark Quill
seed: Courier and route accountant. Exceptional at remembering stories, vulnerable to a source who makes her feel trusted.
design: Magpie, black-and-white feathers, cobalt courier cape, red ankle cord and layered map wallet.
history: Millmere ferry runner who joined the Wayfarers at nineteen. Learned that a story travels faster than a correction.
desire: To be the courier whose report people can build a journey around.
contradiction: A source who makes her feel uniquely trusted can bypass her skepticism.
relationships: Sela is captain; Pip supplies tips; Tessera studies her habits; Senn is a respected route contact.
arc: Publishes a correction with the same energy as the original claim and protects a source without laundering a lie.
story_engine: A delivery race with conflicting obligations; a message whose intended recipient no longer wants it.
writer_truth: She once repeated a rumor about Nix’s family and never knew its full harm.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.

performance.motion_rule: Use a held body pose for dialogue with separate mouth shapes, blinks and intentional expression changes. Preserve facial landmarks.
